jobs.description:
Das 1836 gegründete Schweizer Familienunternehmen zählt heute mit seinem erlesenen Sortiment zu den renommiertesten Confiserien Europas. Die Produkte aus dem Hause Sprüngli stehen für beste Qualität, einmalige Frische und Natürlichkeit. Die vollendeten Kreationen bringen täglich Kundinnen und Kunden aus aller Welt ins Schwärmen.

Schnupperlehre Bäcker-Konditor-Confiseur mit Fachrichtung Confiserie EFZ oder EBA

100%, Dietikon

Arbeiten bei Sprüngli

Du interessierst dich für eine Ausbildung als Bäcker-Konditor-Confiseur mit Fachrichtung Confiserie EFZ oder EBA und möchtest erste Einblicke in diesen kreativen Beruf gewinnen? Dann ist unsere 4-tägige Schnupperlehre genau das Richtige für dich! Hier kannst du aktiv mitarbeiten, verschiedene Abteilungen und Produkte unserer Produktion kennenlernen sowie deine eignenden Kreationen herstellen.

Wichtig: Für die Teilnahme an einer Schnupperlehre ist es wichtig, dass du um 07.00 Uhr bei uns in Dietikon sein kannst. Bitte beachte zudem, dass wir im November und Dezember 2026 keine Schnupperlehren anbieten können.

Was du bei uns bewegst

• Einblick in die vielseitige Welt der Bäckerei, Konditorei und Confiserie

• Kennenlernen unserer Produktionsbereiche und deren Abläufe

• Mitarbeit in verschiedenen Abteilungen

• Erstellung eines eigenen Schnupperberichts

• Dekorieren deiner eigenen Torte mit professioneller Anleitung

• Begleitung durch erfahrene und langjährige Mitarbeitende
 Dauer und Ablauf: Unsere Schnupperlehre dauert 4 Tage und kann nicht verkürzt werden. In dieser Zeit bekommst du einen umfassenden Einblick in die handwerkliche Kunst eines Bäcker-Konditors/Confiseurs und kannst deine Leidenschaft für diesen Beruf entdecken.

Was wir uns wünschen

• Interesse an handwerklicher Arbeit und Lebensmitteln

• Freude am kreativen Gestalten

• Sorgfalt und eine genaue Arbeitsweise

• Teamfähigkeit und Einsatzbereitschaft

Darauf kannst du dich freuen

Nutze diese Gelegenheit, um deine ersten Erfahrungen in einem faszinierenden Berufsfeld zu sammeln. Wir freuen uns darauf, dich in unserer Produktion willkommen zu heissen!

Bist du interessiert?
Dann freuen wir uns auf deine elektronische Bewerbung.*
Derzeit nehmen wir keine Bewerbungen von Stellenvermittlungen für diese Position entgegen.

Bäcker-Konditor-Confiseur specializzato in Confiserie EFZ o EBA

100%, Dietikon

Lavorare a Sprüngli

Sei interessato ad un apprendistato come pasticciere-confectioner-confectioner con una specializzazione in Confiserie EFZ o EBA e vorresti ottenere informazioni iniziali in questa professione creativa? Allora il nostro tirocinio di prova di 4 giorni è giusto per voi! Qui puoi partecipare attivamente, conoscere diversi reparti e prodotti della nostra produzione e creare le tue creazioni.

Durata e scadenza: il nostro apprendistato di prova dura 4 giorni e non può essere accorciato. Durante questo periodo si otterrà una panoramica completa dell'artigianato di un panettiere/confectioner e scoprire la vostra passione per questa professione.

Importante: Per l'apprendistato di prova è necessario essere con noi a Dietikon alle 07.00.

Cosa fai con noi

• Insight nel mondo versatile di panetteria, pasticceria e confiserie

• Scopri le nostre aree di produzione e i loro processi

• Cooperazione in vari dipartimenti

• Preparazione del tuo rapporto di prova

• Decorare la propria torta con guida professionale

• Assistenza da parte di dipendenti esperti e a lungo termine

Cosa vogliamo

• Interessi nel lavoro artigianale e nel cibo

• La gioia del design creativo

• Cura e metodi di lavoro precisi

• Lavoro di squadra e disponibilità

Non vedo l'ora.

Cogliete questa opportunità per ottenere la vostra prima esperienza in un campo professionale affascinante. Non vediamo l'ora di darvi il benvenuto alla nostra produzione!

Founded in 1836, the Swiss family business is today one of the most renowned confiseries in Europe with its exquisite range. The products from Sprüngli stand for the best quality, unique freshness and naturalness. The completed creations bring customers from all over the world to swarm daily.

Bäcker-Konditor-Confiseur specialising in Confiserie EFZ or EBA

100%, Dietikon

Working at Sprüngli

Are you interested in an apprenticeship as a baker-confectioner-confectioner with a specialisation in Confiserie EFZ or EBA and would like to gain initial insights into this creative profession? Then our 4-day trial apprenticeship is just right for you! Here you can actively participate, get to know different departments and products of our production and create your own creations.

Duration and expiration: Our trial apprenticeship lasts 4 days and cannot be shortened. During this time you will get a comprehensive insight into the craftsmanship of a baker/confectioner and discover your passion for this profession.

Important: For the trial apprenticeship you must be able to be with us in Dietikon at 07.00 am.

What you do with us

• Insight into the versatile world of bakery, pastry and confiserie

• Get to know our production areas and their processes

• Cooperation in various departments

• Preparation of your own trial report

• Decorating your own cake with professional guidance

• Assistance by experienced and long-term employees

What we want

• Interest in artisanal work and food

• The joy of creative design

• Care and precise working methods

• Teamwork and readiness

You can look forward to it.

Take this opportunity to gain your first experience in a fascinating professional field. We look forward to welcoming you to our production!

Are you interested?
Then we look forward to your electronic application. *
We are not currently accepting applications from recruitment agencies for this position.

descriptionByLocale.en:
Founded in 1836, the Swiss family business is now one of the most renowned confectioneries in Europe with its exquisite range. The products from Sprüngli stand for the best quality, unique freshness and naturalness. The perfect creations make customers from all over the world go into raptures every day.

Apprenticeship: Commercial clerk (service & administration) for 2027

100%, Dietikon

Working at Sprüngli

As a prospective clerk at Confiserie Sprüngli, you will be guided through various exciting departments during your 2.5-year apprenticeship at our production site in Dietikon. These include finance and controlling, accounts receivable and accounts payable, cash management, purchasing, human resources and payroll accounting. You will also gain an insight into the demanding tasks of the Corporate Clients and Marketing and Communications departments.
You will get to know them during a six-month phase at the headquarters in Zurich. Hardly any other profession offers such a wide range of activities and areas of responsibility as that of a businessman.

Start of teaching: Monday, 09 August 2027

What you can do with us

• Collaboration in various commercial departments and getting to know diverse areas of the company

• Support with HR topics such as applications, admissions and personnel administration (3rd year of apprenticeship)

• Organization and coordination of appointments, meetings and internal events

• Collaboration on exciting projects and step-by-step assumption of own responsibility

• Creation of presentations, evaluations and other important documents

What we want

• Good secondary school leaving certificate

• Good grades in mathematics and a flair for numbers

• Completed Multicheck for Merchants (www.multicheck.ch)

• Enjoyment of contact with people as well as administration and PC activities

• Well-groomed appearance

• Ability to work in a team and good manners

• Reliability and a sense of responsibility

• Willingness to learn something new again and again

What you can look forward to

• Apprenticeship at one of the most renowned confectioneries in Switzerland

• Motivated trainers with excellent specialist knowledge

• Interesting and varied basic education

• 2 interesting introductory days with all new apprentices

• Inter-company courses: Industry knowledge on the subject of services and administration

• 6 weeks vacation

• Assumption of the costs of school materials

• Free courses at the vocational school

• Annual apprentice excursion

Are you interested?
Then we look forward to receiving your electronic application.*
We are currently not accepting applications from recruitment agencies for this position.

Founded in 1836, the Swiss family business is today one of the most renowned confiseries in Europe with its exquisite range. Sprüngli products stand for the best quality, unique freshness and naturalness. The completed creations bring customers from all over the world to swarm daily.

Apprenticeship: retail specialist EFZ, Zurich, Basel and Wallisellen for 2027

100%,

Working at Sprüngli

Retail professionals know about the products they sell. They are sociable people and respond with interest and patience to the wishes of the customer and keep calm, even if it gets hectic. Basic training in the retail trade focuses on activity in the sales business. Aspiring retail professionals learn to advise customers professionally. This means that they know the range, provide information and can advise customers. A special variety offers individual customer orders, such as a special birthday cake or a rich aperitif.
The training lasts 3 years. The additional training for the DHF for retail assistants lasts 2 years. Next possible start of teaching: August 2026.

Development opportunities after basic education

• Vocational trainers/bakery confectionery confectionery

• Industry specialist/in bakery-pastry-confiserie (occupational examination)

• Dipl. Kaufmann/-frau Bäckerei-Konditoerei-Confiserie (Higher expert examination)

For more information you will find the link to the brochure of the retail specialist /-mann bakery-pastry-confiserie: www.forme-deine-zukunft.ch

What you do with us

Retail professionals have a creative flair and pack gift items skillfully and imaginatively. You collect the amount and serve the cashier. As sales professionals, they offer the customer a solution to a complaint and present the freshly produced products tastefully and invitingly, so that the customer is encouraged to buy.

What we want

• Sek A or good Sek B school leaving

• Joy of contact with people and high communication ability

• Friendly, well-groomed appearance

• Careful, orderly work

• Good understanding and vitality

• Interest in high-quality products

• Reliability and commitment

• Physical and psychological resilience

You can look forward to that.

• Training at one of the most renowned confiseries in Switzerland

• Motivated trainers with excellent expertise

• Interesting and varied basic education

• 2 interesting introductory days with all new learners

• Use in our production plant, ordering service and Atelier Crèation

• Internal training days
• Participation in the professional competition “Decorissima”

• An additional learning week in the third year of training

• Attendance of certificate courses at the vocational school

• Costs of school equipment

• Annual apprenticeship trip

Are you interested?
Then we look forward to your electronic application. *
We are not currently accepting recruitment applications for this position.
